evals.prompt: research context engineering for AI agents
evals.expected_output: A cited markdown report written to references/research/ produced by exactly one researcher subagent

assertions.text: Exactly one Agent tool call was made with subagent_type 'mechaswift:researcher'
A file matching references/research/\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}-context-engineering[a-z0-9-]*\.md was written
Tool trace shows brightdata MCP tools were used (search_engine, search_engine_batch, scrape_as_markdown, or scrape_batch)
Tool trace does NOT mention WebFetch or WebSearch
The orchestrator itself made zero direct brightdata calls — all brightdata calls happened inside the researcher subagent

evals.prompt: compare LangGraph vs CrewAI vs AutoGen for agent orchestration
evals.expected_output: A comparison report produced by three parallel researchers, one per framework

assertions.text: Exactly three Agent tool calls were made with subagent_type 'mechaswift:researcher'
All three Agent calls were dispatched in a single assistant response (parallel dispatch)
The final report has a comparison structure with a dedicated section for LangGraph, CrewAI, and AutoGen
Tool trace shows brightdata MCP tools were used
Tool trace does NOT mention WebFetch or WebSearch

evals.prompt: research the current state of OSS vector databases
evals.expected_output: Output file path matches the canonical naming convention

assertions.text: Output file path matches the regex references/research/\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}-[a-z0-9-]+\.md
The date in the filename is today's date
The slug portion of the filename is kebab-case and contains 3 to 5 hyphen-separated words

evals.prompt: compare Postgres vs MySQL vs SQLite for embedded analytics
evals.expected_output: Citations are globally renumbered with no gaps and no duplicates

assertions.text: The final report contains a '### Sources' section
Source citations are numbered sequentially starting at [1] with no gaps
No two numbered Sources entries share the same URL
Every inline [N] citation in the report body resolves to an entry in the Sources section

evals.prompt: research the tradeoffs of monorepos vs polyrepos

assertions.text: Report does not contain the phrase 'I found'
Report does not contain the phrase 'I researched'
Report does not contain the phrase 'In my research'
Report does not contain the phrase 'My findings'
Report does not contain the phrase 'We searched'
Report does not contain the phrase 'Based on my research'

evals.prompt: research best practices for prompt caching with Claude
evals.expected_output: Verify step ran: request was saved and re-read, coverage line printed

assertions.text: A file matching tmp/research/<slug>/request.md was written before the report file
tmp/research/<slug>/request.md was read after being written and before the final assistant response
The final assistant response includes a line beginning with 'addressed:'

evals.prompt: --depth quick research the history of MCP
evals.expected_output: Quick depth dispatches one researcher with a search budget of 3

assertions.text: Exactly one Agent tool call was made with subagent_type 'mechaswift:researcher'
The dispatch prompt passed to the researcher contains the substring 'Search budget: 3'
The '--depth quick' flag does not appear in the final report or in the topic passed to the researcher
